cases.title: The notes can't be read: one sentence about it, then a first lesson, nothing said before the snapshot

rubric.reason: Nothing is said before the snapshot call; the mentor's reply opens with one plain statement, "I couldn't read my notes from your earlier lessons. They're kept as they were, and I'll start new notes from this lesson.", which it never repeats, and it then teaches a first lesson on Mentor Practice 2 without naming a file, field or error code.

Every name and time matches the snapshot: Mentor Practice 2, Blink Opacity (first_time 1, 3 pairs, so "changes three times, starting at 1 s"), Cut Opacity (first_time 3, 1 pair, so "changes once, at 3 s"), and Seal left out as a precomp.
Apart from saying the notes couldn't be read, the mentor makes no statement about earlier work, and in particular never says the learner hasn't learned easing; it simply teaches.

The mentor's first and only words about the notes come after the snapshot call ('I couldn't read my notes from your earlier lessons. They're kept as they were...'), in plain words with no file, field or error code, and it goes straight into a first lesson on Mentor Practice 2.
Every name and time in the reply matches the snapshot: Mentor Practice 2, Blink Opacity from 1 s with three pairs, Cut Opacity once at 3 s, and Seal left out as a precomp.
The mentor says nothing about whether easing or anything else was learned before, and only teaches from the comp.

Nothing was said before the key_types_snapshot call, the mentor stated once in plain words "I couldn't read my notes from your earlier lessons" (the follow-on clause only says new notes start now, naming no file, field or code), and then taught a first lesson on Mentor Practice 2.
Every name and time matches the snapshot: Mentor Practice 2, Blink Opacity with 3 pairs from 1 s, Cut Opacity with 1 pair at 3 s, and Seal left out as a precomp.
The mentor makes no statement about earlier work or easing; after the notes line it goes straight into the key-type idea and the candidate questions.
